description: Execute a command in a container of a pod via the Kubernetes API (no kubectl). Captures stdout/stderr and returns them when the command completes.

args.description: Exact argv to execute without a shell, e.g., ["/bin/ls","-la"]. Provide this OR command.

argv.description: Whitespace-separated argv to execute without a shell (e.g., "/usr/bin/env printenv"). Convenience for CLI; prefer args[] when possible.

command.description: Shell command to run. Defaults to trying /bin/bash first, then /bin/sh, then other common shells. Provide this OR args[].

container.description: Container name (optional; defaults to first container)

shell.description: Shell binary used when command is provided (default /bin/sh)

stdin.description: Optional data to write to process stdin before closing it

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time to wait for command completion (default 60s)

name: kube_pod_exec
title: Execute Command in Kubernetes Pod
